text.text: Hey there 👋 I'm TaskBot. I'm here to assign you tasks, accept your submissions, and give you help!

*1️⃣ Receiving Tasks.* I'll send you two types of tasks:
• *Data collection tasks* — Go take a photo that matches the task description. You must *Accept* before submitting.
• *Verification tasks* — Review someone else's photo: see our AI (Gemini) decision and click *Agree* or *Disagree*. No need to type anything.

Each task shows: *Start time*, *Window*, *Description*, and *Compensation*. Compensation is added to your account *immediately* when you complete a task (submit a photo or click Agree/Disagree).

*2️⃣ Accepting Tasks.* For data collection tasks, press *Accept* before you can submit. For verification tasks, you can respond right away with Agree or Disagree. Remember, you can't change your answer once you accept or reject a task.

*3️⃣ Submitting a Photo (data collection tasks only).*
    *1.* Complete the task's objective
    *2.* Go to the @TaskBot DM channel here on Slack
    *3.* Type the task number and attach that task's image (see example below)

*4.* Send the message!
    *5.* Your compensation is added to your account right away. Reply `account` anytime to see your balance and completed tasks.

*4️⃣ Verification Tasks.* When you get a verification task, you'll see:
• The original task description
• Someone's submitted image
• Our AI (Gemini) decision (MATCH or NO MATCH) and reason

Just click *Agree* if you agree with Gemini, or *Disagree* if you don't. Your compensation is added immediately. You can only submit one photo task at a time, but verification tasks are quick — just click a button!

🌸 *Frequently Asked Questions* 🌸

*When & how will I get paid?*
Points are added to your account as soon as you complete each task. You'll receive the full amount you've earned at the end of the program (e.g., in the form of e-gift cards).

*When will I receive tasks?*
TaskBot sends out tasks periodically. You may receive data collection tasks (take photos) or verification tasks (review others' photos). You may not get one every time.
